_about: POST {HQ_URL}/webhook/sos. HQ_URL today: http://100.85.160.126:5678 (n8n on kaakserver, Tailscale only). See hq/README.md.

batch.text: نحن أربعة في الطابق الأول. والدي يحتاج إلى الأنسولين.

_request_notes: audio: a path relative to simBase (set in the n8n 'Check cache' node) or an absolute URL. null = text only.
text: used if there is no audio or transcription fails.

replies.text: وصلت رسالتك إلى المقر. سيتم إرسال الأنسولين مع الشاحنة التالية.
replies.audio_b64: <base64 MP3 of the spoken reply, or null if text-to-speech failed>
replies.english: There are four of us on the first floor. My father needs insulin.

_response_notes: degraded: true means Claude was unavailable and a fixed reply in the household's language was used.
A resent sos_id is answered from HQ's cache without calling any API (only complete, non-degraded replies are cached).
Play audio with new Audio(replyAudioSrc(reply)).play() from sim/hq_link.js.

response_503.error: Some SOS notes could not be transcribed; resend the batch later.
replies: <replies for the SOS notes that did work>

_503_notes: hq_link.js treats 503 as HQ down: it keeps the whole batch and retries with backoff; finished ones come back from the cache.
